text:
Bedroom for Rent in High-Vibration Meditation House
A chance for blessed person to live onsite at a power spot in Los Angeles and be directly trained by a spiritual master. This is a high vibration house with a sunny bedroom in a peaceful 2 bed / 1 bath home that also serves as a meditation and soul healing center in the Marina Del Rey-Culver City area.

The Room
Your room gets beautiful eastern morning light, filling the space with sunshine to start your day in a really positive way.
• Can be furnished or unfurnished
• If furnished, we can provide: two chairs, bookshelf, and a pull-out couch/bed (as you prefer).

The Home & Vibe

This is a truly special space. The home has pictures and statues of saints and divine souls from multiple traditions—you’ll see Indian saints alongside Jesus and Mary, because we believe in the unity of all religions and welcome those who value truth, right action, peace, and love.

We travel to India regularly and have a second home at an ashram in South India, where we’ve learned ancient healing and meditation techniques through the lineage of avatars Shirdi Sai Baba, Sri Kaleshwar and Jesus. These teachings are designed to bring the mind down and pull balance, positively transform your life experience. heal, care for and grow our soul, love all and serve all, and uplift one another. The purpose of the center is to share these healing and enlightening teachings with those who are open.

We host weekly / bi-monthly / monthly gatherings, and quarterly retreats mostly online to date. The energy of the property is often described as deeply calming, healing, and transformational.

Location

Super convenient for commuting and beach access:
• Right by the 90 and 405 (about 3 minutes to either)
• Immediately off Centinela Blvd
• Close to bus stops, grocery stores, restaurants, parks, gyms
• Straight down Culver Blvd to the beach

Rent & Terms
• $2199/month (plus utilities)
• Security deposit: $2100
• Move-in total: $4,599
• Driveway parking spot
• Lease through at least July 2028

House Guidelines (important)

To keep the home’s purpose and energy consistent:
• Vegetarian household (fish and eggs ok)
• No drugs or alcohol
• No couples
• We’re looking for someone who is either already a meditator or open to learning, and open to helping maintain our home/center’s energy.

Bonus points if you love plants — we have lush indoor and outdoor foliage, and light gardening help is appreciated.

Roommate has been gone abroad on average 3+ months during the year.

Interested? Please reach out if this touches you and send a message with a little about you, as well as answers to the below questions:
1. If you have a job/what is it/typical hours?
2. Are you a meditator/like to learn?
3. When would you like to move in (open now through June. Lease signed by April 30 move in anytime through June 30).

About You: We are looking for an easy going, relaxed, clean, honest and light-hearted team-player who meditates daily and is open to meeting new people. Optimally you are someone who wants to deepen your connection with the divine and your own soul and engage in our soul-growing events. Ideally you want to participate in maintaining the energy and help clean the house, water plants, etc. Someone, for example, who helps puts dishes away, takes out the trash, and home duties. You are a vegetarian. Bonus points if you like gardening or yard work (or would like to improve your green thumb). We prefer someone who either works and/or goes to school. Someone who pays bills on time and is respectful and tidy.

About Your Roommate: Your other roommate is a friendly + thoughtful master meditator, Eastern alternative Doctor, healer and teacher. She has been living a lot in India the last 20 years. She is a full time meditation teacher and healer of these divine channels who works from this home when she is residing here. She leads spiritual journeys abroad and has been traveling an average 3+ months of the year bridging the Eastern wisdom in the West. She leads classes and events online and in-person. She loves being of service, being in nature, is social, kombucha, and loves sharing meals and positive experiences with people.
